about.title: We build tools for the people who actually sell
about.subtitle: Loukdo is made in Phnom Penh for the millions of Cambodians who run real businesses inside chat apps.
about.storyBody: We watched a local seller managing six different chat apps simultaneously. Orders were coming in from Telegram, Messenger, and Instagram. Her only system? A heavily scribbled notebook. She was losing orders, confusing payments, and stressed beyond belief. We knew there had to be a better way to support the backbone of our digital economy.
about.storyImageAlt: A handwritten Khmer sales notebook next to a phone showing chat orders
about.belief1Body: Every contact, every conversation, every order history belongs to the seller. Not to us. Export it whenever you want.
about.belief2Body: Khmer isn't a translation layer bolted on after launch. It's how we design, write and support.
about.belief3Body: Uptime, security and data protection aren't enterprise features. They're the baseline.

conduct.title: User Code of Conduct
conduct.introBody1: LOUKDO is used by thousands of sellers, their teams and their customers. This Code sets out what we expect from everyone on the Platform. It applies to Sellers, their staff, and anyone contacting our support team.
conduct.introBody2: It's short on purpose. The principle is simple: sell honestly, treat people decently, don't damage the Platform.
conduct.introBody3: Breaching it can cost you your Account.
conduct.s1Do1: Describe products accurately — real photos, real condition, real specifications
conduct.s1Do2: Display the full price, including delivery, before checkout
conduct.s1Do5: Answer questions about your product truthfully
conduct.s1Do6: Tell the customer promptly if an item is out of stock
conduct.s1Dont1: Use photos of products you aren't actually selling
conduct.s1Dont2: Post fake "was" prices or invented discounts
conduct.s1Dont4: Sell counterfeit, replica or unlicensed branded goods
conduct.s1Dont5: Take payment for stock you don't have and can't get
conduct.s1Dont6: Add fees at checkout that weren't disclosed
conduct.s2Intro: Whether you're messaging a customer, a supplier, a colleague or our support team:
conduct.s2_2: Hate speech or discrimination based on ethnicity, nationality, religion, gender, sexual orientation, disability, or age
conduct.s2_3: Sexual harassment or unwanted sexual content
conduct.s2_4: Doxxing — publishing someone's private information without consent
conduct.s2_5: Encouraging or coordinating harm against any person or group
conduct.s2_6: Impersonating another person, business or LOUKDO itself
conduct.s2Outro: Disagreements happen. A customer complaint that is angry is not abuse. Sustained personal attacks are. Use the block and report tools rather than escalating.
conduct.s3Intro: Your customers trust you with their names, phone numbers and addresses.
conduct.s3_1: Collect only what you need to complete the order
conduct.s3_2: Use it only to fulfil that order and provide support
conduct.s3_3: Never sell, rent or trade your customer list
conduct.s3_4: Never share a customer's details in a group chat, a screenshot or a public post
conduct.s3_5: Don't add customers to broadcast lists without their agreement
conduct.s3_6: Delete data you no longer need
conduct.s3_7: Keep your account secure — an unlocked account is a data breach waiting to happen
conduct.s4_1: Message people who have contacted you or agreed to hear from you
conduct.s4_3: Follow the messaging rules of each channel — Meta, Telegram and TikTok each have their own, and breaking them can get your business page banned, not just your LOUKDO account
conduct.s4_5: Don't use automation to evade a channel's rate limits
conduct.s5_1: Attempt to access another user's account or data
conduct.s5_2: Probe, scan or test the security of the Platform without written permission
conduct.s5_3: Introduce malware, or use the Platform to distribute it
conduct.s5_4: Scrape the Platform or its users' data
conduct.s5_5: Create multiple accounts to evade limits, fees or suspension
conduct.s5_6: Reverse engineer, decompile or copy the Platform
conduct.s5_7: Use the Platform in a way that degrades performance for others
conduct.s5Outro: Found a security flaw? Report it to support@loukdo.com. We'll work with you and we won't come after you for good-faith research.
conduct.s6Intro: You are responsible for complying with Cambodian law and any other law that applies to your business, including:
conduct.s6_1: Law on E-Commerce (2019) — licensing, electronic contracts, consumer information
conduct.s6_2: Law on Consumer Protection (2019) — fair trading, accurate representation, unfair contract terms
conduct.s6_3: Law on Taxation — VAT registration and remittance where applicable
conduct.s6_4: Law on Trademarks and copyright law — sell only what you have the right to sell
conduct.s6_5: Any sector-specific licensing for your goods — cosmetics, food, health products, alcohol
conduct.s6Outro: If you sell across borders, the destination country's rules apply too.
conduct.s7_1: Our support staff are people. They will be patient, honest and will escalate what they can't solve.
conduct.s7_2: We do not tolerate abuse of support staff. Threats, slurs or sustained aggression will end the conversation and may end the Account. This is not negotiable.
conduct.s8_1: Report a Seller, or illegal content or security issue: support@loukdo.com
conduct.s8Outro1: Include: what happened, who was involved, when, and any screenshots or order references. We acknowledge reports within [1] business day.
conduct.s8Outro2: We do not tolerate retaliation against anyone who reports in good faith. We also act against bad-faith reports made to harm a competitor.
conduct.s9Title: 9. What happens when someone breaches this Code
conduct.s9Intro: We aim to be proportionate. Depending on severity, history and intent, we may:
conduct.s9Action1: Warning and guidance on what to fix
conduct.s9Action2: Feature restriction — e.g. messaging or store publishing paused
conduct.s9Action5: Referral to law enforcement or the relevant regulator
conduct.s9Straight: We may move straight to termination for serious breaches: fraud, child safety violations, threats of violence, or serious illegality.
conduct.s9Appeals: Appeals. If you believe we got it wrong, email support@loukdo.com within [14] days with your Account details and an explanation. A team member not involved in the original decision will review it and respond within [10] business days.
conduct.s10_1: We may update this Code. Material changes are notified in-product or by email at least [14] days in advance.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.summaryBody1: We collect the information we need to run LOUKDO and nothing more. We don't sell your data. Sellers own their customer data — we only process it on their instructions. You can access, correct, export or delete your data by emailing support@loukdo.com.
privacy.s1Title: 1. Who is responsible for your data
privacy.s1_1: [E3Byte Co., Ltd.], #St 317, Phumi 7, Sangkat Beoung Kok 1, Khan Toul Kok, Phnom Penh, Cambodia], Phnom Penh, Cambodia, operates www.loukdo.com.
privacy.s1_3: Note on Cambodian law: As of the date above, Cambodia's Law on Personal Data Protection remains in draft, with a verification workshop held by the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications in August 2026. In the meantime, personal data in Cambodia is protected under the Constitution, the Civil Code, the Criminal Code, and sector-specific laws including the Law on E-Commerce (2019). We have chosen to build our practices to the standard of the draft law and international norms rather than the current minimum. We will update this policy when the law is promulgated.
privacy.s2_1: LOUKDO handles personal data in two distinct capacities:
privacy.s2_2: As a controller — for data about our own users: the sellers and staff who hold LOUKDO accounts, website visitors, and people who contact us. We decide why and how this data is used, and this policy governs it.
privacy.s2_3: As a processor — for data about our sellers' customers: the buyers whose names, phone numbers and addresses flow through a seller's inbox and orders. The seller is the controller of that data. We process it only on the seller's instructions, to deliver the service.
privacy.s3RowAccountExamples: Name, email, phone, password hash, language
privacy.s3RowBusinessExamples: Business name, address, business type, registration/licence numbers, VAT TIN
privacy.s3RowBillingExamples: Plan, billing address, payment method token, invoice history
privacy.s3RowContentExamples: Products, images, prices, orders, messages, notes
privacy.s3_1Note: We do not store full card numbers. Payment card data is handled by our payment processor; we store only a token and the last four digits.
privacy.s3_2a: Device and connection: IP address, browser type and version, operating system, device identifiers, screen resolution
privacy.s3_2b: Usage: pages viewed, features used, timestamps, session duration, referring URL, clicks
privacy.s3_2d: Approximate location: derived from IP address, at city level, for security and localization
privacy.s3_3a: Connected channels (Meta, Telegram, TikTok): messages, profile names and IDs, and the permissions you granted
privacy.s3_3b: Payment providers: transaction status, confirmation references
privacy.s3_3d: Fraud and security vendors: risk signals
privacy.s3_4Body: We do not intentionally collect sensitive personal data — health data, biometric data, political opinions, religious beliefs, trade union membership, or sexual orientation. Do not upload it. If you must handle such data for your business, you are the controller and must have your own lawful basis. We do not knowingly collect data from anyone under 18. If we learn we have, we delete it. Contact support@loukdo.com if you believe this has happened.
privacy.s4Title: 4. Why we use it, and on what basis
privacy.s4Row1Purpose: Provide the Platform and its features
privacy.s4Row6Purpose: Detect and prevent fraud and abuse
privacy.s4Row10Purpose: Comply with tax, accounting and licensing law
privacy.s4Row11Purpose: Establish, exercise or defend legal claims
privacy.s4Outro: Where we rely on legitimate interests, we have assessed that our interest does not override your rights. You can ask for that assessment at support@loukdo.com.
privacy.s5_1: We do not sell your personal data. Not to advertisers, not to data brokers, not to anyone.
privacy.s5_2: We do not sell or share sellers' customer lists.
privacy.s5_3: We do not use the content of your customer conversations to market to your customers.
privacy.s5_4: We do not use your Customer Data to train third-party AI models.
privacy.s5_5: We do not run advertising on the Platform.
privacy.s6Intro: We share personal data only as described here:
privacy.s6ProvidersTitle: Service providers acting on our instructions
privacy.s6ProvidersIntro: — under written contracts requiring confidentiality and equivalent protection:
privacy.s6Authorised: Connected services you authorize — messaging channels, payment providers and couriers you choose to connect. Data flows to them under their own terms.
privacy.s6Legal: Legal and safety disclosures — where required by law, court order, or a valid request from a Cambodian authority, or where necessary to protect the rights, safety or property of LOUKDO, our users, or the public. Where legally permitted, we will notify you first.
privacy.s6BusinessTransfers: Business transfers — in a merger, acquisition or sale of assets, subject to the acquirer honoring this policy. We will notify you before your data becomes subject to a different policy.
privacy.s7_1: Some of our providers operate outside Cambodia. Where data is transferred abroad, we ensure appropriate safeguards: contractual protections including standard data protection clauses, a due-diligence assessment of the recipient, and encryption in transit and at rest.
privacy.s7_2: If you are a bank or financial institution, note that the National Bank of Cambodia's outsourcing and risk management guidance may impose additional requirements on cross-border processing of your data — tell us before onboarding so we can address it.
privacy.s8Row2Retention: Life of the account + [30] days for export
privacy.s8Row3Retention: [10] years — Cambodian tax and accounting law
privacy.s8Row8Data: Data relating to a legal claim
privacy.s8Row8Retention: Until the claim is fully resolved
privacy.s8Outro: Confirm the tax retention period with your accountant — this drives the whole table.
privacy.s9_1: Access — get a copy of the personal data we hold about you
privacy.s9_3: Delete — have your data erased, where we have no overriding legal basis to keep it
privacy.s9_4: Restrict — limit how we use your data while a dispute is resolved
privacy.s9_5: Object — object to processing based on legitimate interests, including profiling
privacy.s9_6: Port — receive your data in a structured, machine-readable format
privacy.s9_7: Withdraw consent — at any time, without affecting processing already carried out
privacy.s9_8: Complain — to us, and to the relevant Cambodian authority once a data protection regulator is established under the Law on Personal Data Protection
privacy.s9Outro1: To exercise any right: email support@loukdo.com from your registered address.
privacy.s9Outro2: We respond within [30] days. Complex requests may take longer — we'll tell you if so and why. We may ask you to verify your identity. There is no charge unless a request is manifestly unfounded or repetitive.
privacy.s10_1: Encryption in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest
privacy.s10_2: Role-based access control, with staff access on a least-privilege basis
privacy.s10_4: Audit logging of access to personal data
privacy.s10_5: Regular vulnerability assessment and penetration testing
privacy.s10_8: Staff training on data protection and security
privacy.s10Outro1: No system is perfectly secure. Your role matters: use a strong unique password, enable two-factor authentication, and remove team access promptly when someone leaves.
privacy.s10Outro2: In a breach affecting your personal data, we will notify you and the relevant authority without undue delay and in any event within [72] hours of becoming aware, describing what happened, what data was involved, what we're doing, and what you should do.
privacy.s11_1: We use automated systems to detect fraud, spam and abuse. These may flag an account for review. Decisions with a significant effect on you — such as suspension — are reviewed by a person before they take effect, except where an immediate automated action is necessary to prevent ongoing harm, in which case human review follows promptly.
privacy.s11_2: You may request human review of any automated decision at support@loukdo.com
privacy.s12Body: See our Cookies Policy for full detail on cookies and similar technologies, and how to control them.
privacy.s13Body: We may update this policy. Material changes will be notified by email or in-product at least [14] days before they take effect. The "Last updated" date always reflects the current version. We keep previous versions available at [loukdo.com/privacy].

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.s1_1: Cookies are small text files a website stores on your device. They let a site remember you between pages and visits — keeping you logged in, remembering your language, and measuring how the site is used.
cookies.s1_2: This policy also covers similar technologies: local storage, session storage, pixels/web beacons, and software development kits (SDKs) in our mobile apps. We call them all "cookies" here.
cookies.s2_1: Keep you signed in and secure your session
cookies.s2_2: Remember your language and display preferences
cookies.s2_3: Protect against fraud and automated attacks
cookies.s2_4: Understand which features are used, so we can improve them
cookies.s3NecessaryIntro: The Platform cannot function without these. They don't require consent and can't be turned off in our banner.
cookies.s4Intro: Some cookies are set by others: analytics providers, advertising platforms, our CDN and bot protection, embedded video players, and payment provider frames. We don't control them. Check their own privacy policies:
cookies.s5BannerBody: On your first visit you can Accept all, reject all (non-essential), or choose by category. Change your mind any time via Cookie Settings in the footer.
cookies.s5BrowserTitle: Your browser. Most browsers let you block or delete cookies:
cookies.s5_1: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Third-party cookies
cookies.s5_3: Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
cookies.s5_4: Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions
cookies.s5Note: Note: blocking strictly necessary cookies will break sign-in and checkout.
cookies.s5Dnt: Do Not Track. There is no common standard for DNT, so we do not currently respond to DNT signals. Use our banner instead — it works.
cookies.s6_1: If you visit a store hosted on loukdo.com or a connected custom domain, cookies are set for cart and checkout functionality. The seller may also add their own tracking tags — for example a Meta Pixel or Google tag. Those are the seller's responsibility and are governed by the seller's own privacy notice.
cookies.s6_2: Sellers: if you add tracking to your store, you must disclose it and obtain consent where required. That's your obligation, not ours.
cookies.s7_1: We'll update this policy as our cookie use changes. Material changes reset the consent banner so you can review your choices.
